purpose: Source-USE qualification: what exact kinds of evidence/claims a specific source is qualified to support, scoped. Distinct from source IDENTITY (source_registry.json) and source CATEGORY. A verified source is NOT universally authoritative.
one_owner_rule: A qualification references exactly one source_id and duplicates NO bibliographic metadata (title/publisher/url/doi/dates/author live only in source_registry.json).

reviewed.entry: scope reviewed against source; not yet ratified

qualified_narrow.entry: ratified for a narrow, explicitly enumerated scope only
qualified_narrow.effect_on_admission: admissible ONLY within the enumerated scope

qualified.entry: ratified for the full stated scope

suspended.regression: downstream privilege must move to <= prior

superseded.entry: replaced by a newer qualification/source edition

no_state_implies_publication: No qualification state authorizes route publication or indexation. Publication is derived by Contract C from independent postures.

qualification_record_schema.revision_rule: qualified_against_source_revision MUST equal the referenced source's identity_revision (owned by source_registry.json). If the source identity_revision changes, this qualification becomes review-required (not admissible). The qualification stores only the revision id, never human-readable bibliographic identity.

qualifications.scope: German Lexikon der Chemie (Spektrum.de) dictionary-entry observation for the MoS2 concept, German-language lexical form only. Mirrors the source's existing reviewed use_for; broadens nothing.
qualifications.note: Language de is NOT geography DE. This qualification grants no geography. Source bibliographic identity/edition is owned by source_registry.json (SRC-SPEKTRUM-MOS2-DE, identity_revision rev-2026-05-30-1); this record stores only the revision reference. It does not change the source's status or source_lock_status.

qualifications.scope: Office des Changes 2024 annual report: official Moroccan recorded-import observation and official value/unit-price measure for the printed product label 'Soufres bruts et non raffinés', reporter=Morocco, flow=imports, period=2024. Scope reviewed this sprint (I verified the exact figures + page locators in the official PDF).
qualifications.note: State 'reviewed' (NOT qualified): the source is brand-new (source status seeded / lock candidate) and has not undergone full governed identity verification, so its use-qualification cannot yet admit. Admission is therefore correctly withheld at the qualification gate. Even if it were qualified_narrow, the SD-TRADE domain requires primary_plus_corroborating and only one non-independent official source exists, so evidence posture would still be evidence_collecting (see pilot report policy finding).

qualifications.scope: Harmonized System 2022 (H6) classification/nomenclature identity ONLY: heading/subheading code and official English description, and the 2503/2802 exclusion boundary. Reviewed against the official UN Comtrade H6 reference; source identity verified (SOURCE_IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md).
qualifications.note: Promoted reviewed -> qualified_narrow this sprint: source identity verified AND scope reviewed, so the narrow, explicitly-enumerated classification-identity scope is ratified. Domain corrected SD-NOMENCLATURE -> SD-CUSTOMS-CLASSIFICATION (goods-classification nomenclature is a customs/statistical fact, NOT chemical naming). Admissible ONLY within HS classification identity / exclusion boundary. Must NEVER qualify Morocco trade totals, trade-flow value, industrial demand, scientific properties, market forecasts, or a Moroccan national code. qualified_narrow admits at the admission gate but implies NO claim approval, NO source-locking, NO route publication, NO indexation.
